sources.title: SB Energy registration statement on Form S-1, filed September 1, 2026

event.title: OpenAI and SB Energy 20-year leases at the PORTS-Pike campus
event.summary: SB Energy subsidiaries signed long-term leases with an OpenAI affiliate for the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio. NVIDIA provided residual value guaranties for part of the tenant's obligations.

participants.note: An affiliate of OpenAI as tenant

quantities.label: Critical IT capacity across the 17 leases (GW-IT)
quantities.quote: On August 17, 2026, 17 of our subsidiaries, each as landlord, and an affiliate of OpenAI, as tenant, entered into individual lease agreements for the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus, resulting in 17 leases covering approximately 8.0 GW-IT of critical IT capacity in the aggregate.

facts.label: Term
facts.text: Each lease has a 20-year initial term from its commencement date.
facts.quote: Each lease has a 20-year initial term commencing on the applicable commencement date

facts.label: Site
facts.text: The campus in Pike County, Ohio, is designed for 17 data center buildings.
facts.quote: means our anticipated data center campus in Pike County, Ohio, designed to comprise 17 data center buildings aggregating approximately 8.0 GW-IT of critical IT capacity

facts.label: Timing
facts.text: The first phase targets the start of operations in 2028.
facts.quote: the first phase is targeting commencement of operations in 2028

facts.label: NVIDIA guaranty
facts.text: NVIDIA guarantees the residual value of the tenant's lease obligations for the first approximately 4.25 GW-IT, up to $105 billion in aggregate.
facts.quote: NVIDIA has provided residual value guaranties of the OpenAI tenant's lease obligations at PORTS-Pike Technology Campus covering only the initial approximately 4.25 GW-IT at an aggregate guaranteed value of $105 billion

facts.label: OpenAI warrants
facts.text: SB Energy issued OpenAI 3,991,809 warrants with a nominal exercise price of $0.01 per share.
facts.quote: "OpenAI Warrants" means the 3,991,809 warrants issued by us to OpenAI pursuant to the Amended and Restated OpenAI Warrant Agreement, dated August 17, 2026, and outstanding as of the date of this prospectus at a nominal exercise price of $0.01 per share

facts.label: Purpose of the warrants
facts.text: The warrants were an inducement for OpenAI to sign the leases.
facts.quote: The warrants were intended as a material inducement for OpenAI to enter into the lease agreements with us.

relations.note: NVIDIA also agreed to invest in SB Energy on the same day.
